description: A compile-time constant read directly (`MAX_NIGHTS`) and through a `fn` chain (`fits` reads `LIMIT = MAX_NIGHTS`) compiles; `setEnd(14)` keeps the invariant, `setEnd(30)` traps before the write (end stays 14).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-invariant-const-read ("Allow compile-time consts (Recommended)"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-const-read: "admit a file-scope const whose initializer is a compile-time constant (literals, enum variants, other such consts) and that is not server-only, directly and through a fn chain".
